description: `kinds` matches exactly or by ONE TRAILING star. Every other wildcard form is a named error rather than a literal match, because a filter that silently matches nothing is the hardest bug in this slice to diagnose from outside: the client is connected and simply never receives anything.

data.what: kind pattern "*.started" has a `*` that is not a single trailing one; use an exact kind or one trailing star, as in `loop.*`
data.means: `kinds` matches exactly or by a single trailing `*`; any other wildcard form is refused rather than treated as a literal, because a filter that matches nothing looks identical to a working subscription
